mentions.name: aip
mentions.description: A collection of Go libraries providing safe default choices for implementing Google's API Improvement Proposals in ConnectRPC services. It includes AIP-161 field masks (with semantics differing from standard field masks) plus middleware for AIP-157 read filtering, and an AUP-160 filter implementation borrowed with attribution from the LuCI project. Planned expansion includes supporting data sources beyond SQL databases and page tokens, and exporting more frequently used middleware.
mentions.problem: Implementing Google's API Improvement Proposals in ConnectRPC services lacks safe defaults.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://github.com/hxtk/aip as a collection of libraries giving safe default choices to implement Google's API improvement proposals in ConnectRPC services. It borrows (with attribution per the license) an unexported implementation of AUP-160 filters from the LuCI project, and I intend to expand it to support data sources other than SQL databases and page tokens, and it also exports an implementation of AIP-161 field masks (which have different semantics compared to standard field masks) and middleware to help with using them for AIP-157 read filtering.
